description: Streets of one Spanish municipality as the cadastre writes them (type code such as CL or AV, name and full name), optionally filtered by part of the name. Spain only (common territory). Take region from list_provinces and municipality from list_municipalities. One API call.

municipality.description: Municipality name as returned by list_municipalities

name.description: Part of the street name to filter by

region.description: Province name as returned by list_provinces

name: list_streets
title: List Spanish Streets
